question: If you are using Ctrl + A keys in MS Word, what are you trying to do ?

options.text: Select all text in the file
Copy all text in the file

solution:
The correct answer is __**Select all text in the file**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Pressing **Ctrl + A** in MS Word selects all the text in the file.
 
• This shortcut is useful for quickly highlighting all the content, allowing for further actions like copying, cutting, or formatting.
 
• It is a common keyboard shortcut a
